lines.text: Got handed the office Christmas party? Twenty-four no-prep games for coworkers. Bingo, trivia, and icebreakers. A forty-five minute run sheet plans it for you. Six to sixty people. Just print and play. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

Eleven pages that run your whole Secret Santa. A sign-up sheet, and a fourteen-question form. Twenty-four name slips, and gift ideas by budget. White elephant and dice swap rules, too. For work, family, or friends. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
